title: Implement retention policy validation at startup
description:
On startup, parse and validate the pinning policy: (1) at least one rule must exist; (2) no rule has both max_age_days=0 and no group filter (would match nothing); (3) any group name in pin_groups must be a valid group name format. If validation fails, print the invalid rule with line number and exit. Artifact: integrated into transit/src/config.rs and transit/src/retention/policy.rs.

Acceptance:
- Empty policy (no rules) prints error and exits 1
- Invalid group name in rule prints error and exits 1
- Overlapping rules emit a warning (not an error) listing which articles match multiple rules
- Unit test: valid policy parses without error; each invalid case returns error
